notes.title: FLOW is going FREE!
notes.content:
FLOW Players,

    Pending heavy consideration and feedback from the community, the team and I have decided
that, going forward, FLOW will be FREE. The average player takes fewer than 40 minutes to
complete FLOW. It plays more like a tech demo than a game, and it is not in a completed and
refined enough state justify charging players. This change will occur December first, and
Requests to refund through Steam Support are preferred: Steam's Refund Policy allows you to
refund any game you have spent less than 2 hours on. We do, however, recognize some people
may be unable to complete a request through Steam, so we are willing to work with those
individuals too. If this is your case, please contact Dallen Larson at dallen@dallenlarson.com.

Thank you all so much for the feedback leading to this decision,
- Dallen Larson and Adam Helquist
